summary: Tested Analytics page redesign with all 10 features. All features working correctly: FY filter, Day/Month/Quarter tabs, Plant dropdown filter, KPI summary cards, Plant-wise Spend chart, Department-wise Spend section, Supplier-wise Spend chart, Project Completion Timelines table, PO search filter, and AI Insights section.

issues: Console warnings about recharts chart dimensions being -1 (width/height) - charts still render correctly but warnings indicate potential layout timing issue
HTML hydration warnings about span inside tr/tbody/th/td - React development warnings, don't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer shows console warnings about width(-1) and height(-1) - this is a known recharts issue when container dimensions are not immediately available. Consider adding minWidth/minHeight props to ResponsiveContainer components to suppress warnings.
